claim_refuted: A quantitatively nonzero determinant of the span-aligned mixed five-dimensional skeleton, by itself and while arbitrary same-bank quadratic curvature is ignored, forces an unweighted L1 characteristic-function bound for that packet.
counterexample: Set B=I_2, d=1, a=b=e_1 and choose same-bank quadratic terms so q_active=(z+x1+y1)^2+(x2+y2)^2. Then the mixed skeleton determinant is -1 but the full active quadratic matrix has rank two. For iid standard Gaussian original coordinates (admissible density cap <1), |phi_active(t)|=(1+36t^2)^(-1/4)(1+16t^2)^(-1/4)~1/(sqrt(24)|t|), so its unweighted L1 norm diverges.
scope_note: This is NOT a counterexample to QFORM and NOT a counterexample to the target-wide L1 criterion: the active packet has only two nonzero eigenvalues. Adding an independent +w^2 direction produces target eigenvalues 3,2,1 and restores an L1 third-square factor. The correction says the global third-direction resource must be aggregated before absolute-value/time integration.
replacement_obligation: In the critical aligned branch, combine a genuine third spectral/grouped-coordinate resource with the packet before taking absolute values; do not spend the mixed-skeleton determinant after discarding same-bank curvature.
